blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court (SC) has dismissed the indirect contempt case filed against Senator Vicente “Tito” Sotto III, saying even “provocative, harsh, or critical statements are still protected speech.” Sotto questioned the SC’s ruling on the 2025 impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte, saying the author of the decision was unfamiliar with congressional rules and that the ruling effectively amended the Constitution. READ: Sotto: Impeachment now an ‘impossible dream’ after SC ruling Sotto’s remarks prompted Atty. Manuelito Luna and several others to ask the SC to cite him for indirect contempt under Rule 71, Section 3(d) of the […]...
